title: Personality 3
note: B2 vocab leaf, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. Two predecessors own 71 traits between them (a2_personality 35, b1_personality 36), so the sweep mattered — but unusually this theme had real room left: only 5 of 59 candidates came back taught (stubborn, sensitive, loyal, modest, outgoing) and were dropped. The layer this unit adds is the vocabulary of judgement rather than description: the strengths colleagues actually name (conscientious, meticulous, resourceful, perceptive, articulate, level-headed), the faults people complain about (self-centred, manipulative, condescending, narrow-minded, indecisive), and temperament words (introverted, extroverted, impulsive, tactful, discreet). C57 card 0 recaps Personality 2. C49 all 36 words across three boards of 12. Build-the-family card is mostly a RECAP bridge: generous, honest and stubborn are adjectives the student already has, and this unit adds their nouns — generosity, honesty, stubbornness — with assertive -> assertiveness as the one new pair. All four derived forms are bank items, and the -ity/-ness endings are the ones b2_suffixes_1 teaches directly. A12 sense on vain (about looks) — *in vain* is the other everyday reading. E10 Use is rewrite production; every underline reconstructs its answer.

cards.title: You already know
cards.note: Personality 2 gave you the everyday describing words — hard-working, easy-going, organised, sensible, thoughtful, tolerant, determined, moody, arrogant, bossy, sociable, reserved, optimistic. Those words come back in this unit's sentences. What is new here is sharper: the words people reach for when they are judging someone rather than describing them, and the traits that only show up under pressure.
cards.note_cz: Personality 2 ti dal běžná popisná slova — hard-working, easy-going, organised, sensible, thoughtful, tolerant, determined, moody, arrogant, bossy, sociable, reserved, optimistic. Ta slova se vracejí ve větách. Nové je tu něco ostřejšího: slova, po kterých lidé sáhnou, když někoho posuzují, a vlastnosti, které se ukážou až pod tlakem.

cards.title: Build the family
points: Three of these adjectives you already know — here are their nouns.
**-ity** and **-ness** do the building, the same endings as Suffixes 2.
